fixture_notes: Demonstrates PASS with zero findings for a software boundary that has a real use-case model but a deliberately empty UIModel.entries array. A validator implementation must NOT report this as a finding, missing model, or incompleteness -- R-011 explicitly states software boundaries do not automatically require a screen. This is the negative-space counterpart to unknown-boundary-type and missing-applicable-model: absence of UI content here is correct, not an error.
